The Police Inspector of Basavangudi Women P.S. has filed chargesheet against Accused No.1 to 4 for the offence punishable U/s.498(A) 506 & Sec.3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
2. The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt.Chitra R.
The gist of the prosecution case is that complainant got married accused No.1 on 30.10.2019.
At the time of marriage, as per the demand of accused No.1 to 4, the parents of the complainant had given gold and household items and also motorcycle to the accused No.1 as dowry.

After marriage, when complainant was residing with accused No.1 to 3 and when she was working in Wipro Company, accused No.1 to 3 were ill-treating and teasing complainant for drawing less salary and demanded complainant to bring cash of Rs.5 lakhs as dowry.
On 30.01.2020, the complainant had gone to Kerala on account of office work.

On her return, accused No.1 to 3 suspected  3  C.C.No.8675/2022 complainant that she had gone to Kerala with another boy and abused her foul and filthy language and forced her to bring additional dowry.

On 11.01.2021, accused No.1 to 4 forced the complainant to bring additional dowry of Rs.5 lakhs and drove her away out of the house and thereby accused NO.1 to 4 caused physical and mental cruelty to the complainant.

sentences.text:
The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused No.1 to 4 caused physical and  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry  and threatened complainant to do away with her life and  thereby accused No.1 to 4 have committed the offences  punishable 498(A) 506 R/w.34 of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of  Dowry Prohibition Act?
2) what order?

8. My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........

As per final order, for the following:
 5  C.C.No.8675/2022  R E A S ON S  9. POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.
In order to bring home the guilt of the accused No.1 to 4, the prosecution has examined complainant Smt. Chitra R. as PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P.2 documents.
Ex.P1 is the first information statement and Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.

10. PW-1 in her examination-in-chief deposed that her marriage with accused No.1 was performed on 30-10-2019 and after the marriage, accused persons looked after her well and deposed accused persons did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and did not threatened her with dire consequences.
PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused persons in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station, there the police have took her signature on documents.

PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first Chithra R vs Mahesh M on 12 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/9303185/
4 information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2
and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P1.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and  6  C.C.No.8675/2022 accused persons have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
Though PW-1 was cross examined by the prosecution

,
nothing worth could be elicited.
11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness has turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.
In view of the material witness, turning hostile the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.

12. POINT No.2:- For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
